name: Hai Van Gate
kicker: 1826 gate on the pass above the bay
summary: Walk the restored gate on the pass and look back at Lang Co bay. The fee from 2 June 2026 is 70,000 VND. Skip it if you only take the tunnel. The tunnel does not pass the gate.
getThere: Up the pass road from Lang Co, not through the tunnel. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: The restored Hai Van Gate, with the stair and the pass behind it

notice.title: The tunnel skips the gate
notice.body: Hải Vân Quan is on the pass road. The road tunnel is the shorter way between Da Nang and Lang Co, and it does not pass the gate. Entry has not been free since 2 June 2026.

body: Walk the restored Nguyễn gate and look back at Vịnh Lăng Cô. It stands above 500 m on the Hue–Da Nang boundary, built in 1826 under Minh Mạng as the southern gate of the capital. Visitors have been allowed in since 1 Aug 2024, after restoration. Both cities manage the national historic site. The south edge of the 2018 Lang Co tourism zone is this pass.

From 2 June 2026 the fee is 70,000 VND per person per visit, the same for domestic and international visitors, through 31 Dec 2028. Children under 1.2 m go free, and residents of Hue and Da Nang, plus policy groups, pay half. Those concessions are not on the other statement of the same fee. Check the board.

Time on the summit is check on arrival. Go in the morning if you want the bay in the light rather than the gate in silhouette. Hours are 07:00–17:30 every day, and also left with no clock. Use the board at the gate if the two disagree.

figures.caption: Lang Co’s curve, from the gate wall on the pass
figures.alt: The curved Lang Co beach seen from the Hai Van Gate, with forested ridges in front

gettingThere: The gate is on the pass road above Lang Co, not on the tunnel. The pass road is longer than the tunnel, and it is how you see the bay from above. Drive minutes from the beach strip are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Lang Co
legs.body: Up the pass road. Do not take the tunnel and assume you have seen the gate. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: The tunnel is about 25 km from the city to Lang Co, and it bypasses the gate. The pass road is longer, and it is the one that reaches Hải Vân Quan. Minutes on the pass road are check on arrival.

hours: 07:00–17:30 every day, and also with no clock stated. Check the board on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day is set. Check the board on arrival.
